panels.title: Aircraft Now
panels.description: Unique aircraft seen in the last 60 seconds

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniq(hex_ident) as count FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 60 SECOND

panels.title: Messages / min
panels.description: ADS-B messages received per minute (last 5 min avg)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() / 5 as msg_per_min FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT uniq(hex_ident) as count FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > today()
SELECT formatReadableQuantity(count()) as total FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > today()
SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(timestamp) AS time, uniq(hex_ident) AS aircraft FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time, count() AS messages FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT altitude FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND altitude IS NOT NULL AND altitude > 0 AND altitude < 50000

SELECT p.hex_ident, argMaxIf(callsign, timestamp, callsign != '') AS last_callsign, any(m.registration) AS registration, any(m.type_code) AS type, max(altitude) AS max_alt_ft, round(avg(ground_speed), 0) AS avg_speed_kts, count() AS msgs, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM adsb.positions p LEFT JOIN (SELECT hex_ident, registration, type_code FROM adsb.aircraft_meta FINAL) m ON p.hex_ident = m.hex_ident WHERE p.timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE GROUP BY p.hex_ident HAVING last_callsign != '' ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Altitude Traces (Top Aircraft)
panels.description: Altitude over time for the 5 most active aircraft in the last hour

targets.rawSql: WITH top_aircraft AS (SELECT hex_ident FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND altitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hex_ident ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT timestamp AS time, altitude AS value, concat(hex_ident, coalesce(concat(' (', callsign, ')'), '')) AS metric FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hex_ident IN (SELECT hex_ident FROM top_aircraft) AND altitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.title: Aircraft Positions - Live
panels.description: Last known position of each aircraft heard in the last 2 minutes, colored by altitude, rotated by track. SBS splits an aircraft's state across message types (callsign in MSG 1, position in MSG 3, track in MSG 4), so each field takes its own latest non-NULL value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hex_ident, argMaxIf(callsign, timestamp, callsign != '') AS callsign, argMaxIf(lat, timestamp, lat IS NOT NULL) AS lat, argMaxIf(lon, timestamp, lon IS NOT NULL) AS lon, argMaxIf(altitude, timestamp, altitude IS NOT NULL) AS altitude, argMaxIf(track, timestamp, track IS NOT NULL) AS track, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE GROUP BY hex_ident HAVING lat IS NOT NULL AND lon IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Airlines Today
panels.description: Unique aircraft per operator today, from the callsign's ICAO prefix (adsb.airlines lookup). '(?)' means the prefix is not in the lookup.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(al.name, concat(substring(callsign, 1, 3), ' (?)')) AS airline, uniq(hex_ident) AS aircraft FROM adsb.positions LEFT JOIN adsb.airlines al ON substring(callsign, 1, 3) = al.icao3 WHERE timestamp > today() AND match(callsign, '^[A-Za-z]{3}') GROUP BY airline ORDER BY aircraft DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Coverage by Bearing (max nm today)
panels.description: Farthest aircraft heard today per compass sector from the station. Shows which directions have clear sky; SW is toward Piraeus and the sea.

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(b < 22.5 OR b >= 337.5, 'N', b < 67.5, 'NE', b < 112.5, 'E', b < 157.5, 'SE', b < 202.5, 'S', b < 247.5, 'SW', b < 292.5, 'W', 'NW') AS sector, round(max(nm), 1) AS max_nm FROM (SELECT greatCircleDistance(23.736, 37.989, lon, lat) / 1852 AS nm, (degrees(atan2(lon - 23.736, lat - 37.989)) + 360) % 360 AS b FROM adsb.positions WHERE timestamp > today() AND lat IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY sector ORDER BY max_nm DESC

panels.title: Notable Today (military / emergency squawk)
panels.description: Aircraft today flagged military in the readsb database, or squawking 7500 (hijack), 7600 (radio failure) or 7700 (emergency). Empty is the normal case.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.hex_ident, anyLast(callsign) AS callsign, any(m.registration) AS registration, anyLast(squawk) AS squawk_code, max(m.mil) AS mil, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM adsb.positions p LEFT JOIN (SELECT hex_ident, registration, mil FROM adsb.aircraft_meta FINAL) m ON p.hex_ident = m.hex_ident WHERE p.timestamp > today() AND (squawk IN ('7500', '7600', '7700') OR m.mil = 1) GROUP BY p.hex_ident ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 50
